<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="hermod-the-spirit-of-war" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Hermod, the Spirit of War</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/j7RO67GrYD.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Hermod is a lieutenant of Rasial, the First Necromancer. He is a phantom born out of the unending conflicts of the God Wars in the Third Age, and continuously reforms himself when destroyed as long as wars are waged on Gielinor. You can only damage him with the Necromancy combat style and poison.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>In order to fight Hermod you must complete </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Spirit_of_War <nowiki>The Spirit of War</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Notable drops:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139533828629741668.png?v=1" alt="hermodicplate" title="hermodicplate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Hermodic plates, which are used for the Necromancy power armour.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139533737617539235.png?v=1" alt="drumsticks" title="drumsticks" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Animated drumsticks, which are used for </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/That_Old_Black_Magic <nowiki>That Old Black Magic</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="useful-items-unlocks"><ins><nowiki>Useful Items &amp; Unlocks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>These are all highly recommended.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayer" title="undeadslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Undead Slayer Ability</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayerperk" title="undeadslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Undead Slayer Perk</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Salve Amulet (e)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=BsEi4iGWqO8sBAge4j3j <nowiki>T90 Necromancy</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/12e1e2c979753d2c9f762232ade6e679ee5f3488e0c9db16dbad205ca9769ac8.webp" alt="Hermod" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=pDaRDMzjF6EjSCVKFjd7 <nowiki>T95 Necromancy</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FpDaRDMzjF6EjSCVKFjd7.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>He will only attack with Necromancy and only has 2 mechanics that differ from autos.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Smash</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When he does this he will draw back his sword and hit your current location. This will disable your protection prayers. When he's about to do it there will be a green aura around the location. Simply move or use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1" alt="veng" title="veng" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and tank it to deal extra damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Conjure</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Roughly every 48 seconds he will summon 2 armoured phantoms and become completely immune to damage until they are dead. If you get this mechanic utilise </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1" alt="threadsoffate" title="threadsoffate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and good abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="rotations"><ins><nowiki>Rotations</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>There are currently 2 rotations which are used.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Both of which require </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalmor" title="igneouskalmor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalzuk" title="igneouskalzuk" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, however for the level 76+ one you can get away without and just remove </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> from the rotation and just do more </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> spam. Equip </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1" alt="excal" title="excal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to dismiss your conjures.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayer" title="undeadslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is not owned, add </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1" alt="deathguard90" title="deathguard90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the end if needed</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
